statement: Pinned Linux hid-steam virtual client open increments client_opened and schedules work_connect; close decrements it and schedules the same work. While client_opened is nonzero, the kernel forwards raw input reports to client_hdev, stops decoding exact-length IBEX 0x42/0x45 into evdev, and sensor_open/sensor_close skip IMU-mode feature writes. work_connect then unregisters the kernel synthetic input/sensor devices while client-opened or disconnected, restoring registration only when connected and not client-opened. The 0x43 battery and 0x79 event paths are not asserted to be skipped in the same way. All are kernel host consumer paths, not measured Steam-client interaction. Linux hid-steam.c lines 1650-1675,1461-1485,2542-2589,948-976. Live hidraw handoff: No evidence.
